name: aspen residence
tagline: Central, fast Wi-Fi, built for work trips
shortDescription: A modern apartment building in the centre of Dehradun, five minutes from Rajpur Road, set up for business travellers and short stays.
description: Aspen Residence is our city-centre building — closest to restaurants, the railway station, and the main business district. Each apartment has a dedicated work desk, blackout curtains, and a kitchenette stocked with the basics.
Most guests here are on work trips of a few days to a couple of weeks. Housekeeping is available on request rather than scheduled, so you're not interrupted mid-call.

rooms.name: Studio Apartment
rooms.notes: 1 bed, kitchenette, work desk, 350 sq ft

rooms.name: 1BHK Apartment
rooms.notes: Separate living room and kitchen, 550 sq ft

location.address: Aspen Residence, near Rajpur Road, Dehradun
location.directionsNote: Gated parking on site. 10 minutes from Dehradun Railway Station, 35 minutes from Jolly Grant Airport.

reviews.text: Stayed two weeks for work. The desk setup and fibre Wi-Fi made it actually usable as a base, not just a place to sleep.
Kitchenette had everything I needed to not eat out every meal. Building felt secure, good elevator, easy parking.
Clean and central. Only note: ask for extra towels at check-in if you need them, wasn't automatic.

name: Cedar Residence
tagline: More space, quieter street, built for families
shortDescription: A quieter apartment building five minutes from Aspen Residence, with larger layouts suited to families and longer stays.
description: Cedar Residence sits on a quieter residential street, with larger 2BHK and 3BHK layouts and a small shared garden on the ground floor. It's the better pick if you're travelling with family or staying longer than a week.
Each apartment has two bathrooms in the larger layouts, a full kitchen rather than a kitchenette, and a washing machine — genuinely set up to live in, not just stay in.

rooms.name: 2BHK Apartment
rooms.notes: Two bedrooms, full kitchen, 850 sq ft

rooms.name: 3BHK Apartment
rooms.notes: Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, 1100 sq ft

location.address: Cedar Residence, off Rajpur Road, Dehradun
location.directionsNote: Five minutes' drive from Aspen Residence. On-site parking for two cars per apartment.

reviews.text: Booked the 3BHK for a week with grandparents and kids. Having a real kitchen and the garden downstairs made it feel like a proper holiday, not a hotel stay.
Quiet street, genuinely spacious, washing machine was a lifesaver on a 10-day trip.
